desc: Ideation: identify convolution/NTT, bitset, and big-integer convolution options; select parity-split big-integer convolution as the primary pure-Python approach.
Implement fast input parsing and a small-N direct O(N^2) fallback (endpoint enumeration with a set) for N <= ~3000.

Implement the parity-split big-integer convolution core: build even/odd compressed indicator integers in base 2^19, square them, extract 19-bit coefficients from little-endian bytes, and compute ans=(sum H0[B]+sum H1[B-1]-N)//2.
Verify samples and edge cases; all 3 public samples passed and edge-case handling (N<3, parity split, self-pair subtraction, padding) is in place.
